liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Wheel** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds The Wheel amazing and memorable, unable to stop thinking about it; Reviewer had never heard this Wheel on tape until hearing it from the archive [11][13]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this Wharf Rat possibly the best version ever, with Jerry's playing central; Reviewer singles out The Wheel and Wharf Rat as standouts [8][15]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.79020.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [1]
- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.80753.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1977-10-07.170389.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 87 min [3]
- **gd77-10-07.pset2-sbd.kiefe-fiske.1191.sbefixed.shnf**: soundboard; 4 songs; 34 min; rated 4.26/5 by 19 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard recording sounds good, though it covers only part of the show; Reviewer describes the sound of the soundboard as superb [6][8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer heard rumors of audience tapes of other pieces, but only this partial soundboard circulates; the Pit hosted basketball, not shows, during their UNM time [7]
- Only the second set is on this source; uploader hopes the first set surfaces later [2]
- Only a partial second set circulates; the first set, from Mississippi Half Step through Sunrise, is not in circulation [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.79020.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1977-10-07.sbd-set2.miller.80753.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: This transfer fixes a dropout in Terrapin Station that was present in the earlier version; A reel flip between Drums and Iko Iko was smoothed over with a crossfade [2]
- **gd1977-10-07.170389.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  February 26, 2025; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: This source repairs a dropout in Sugar Magnolia; Terrapin Station dropout from the earlier version is fixed here; A reel flip between Drums and Iko Iko was repaired with a crossfade [3]
- **gd77-10-07.pset2-sbd.kiefe-fiske.1191.sbefixed.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Soundboard material from The Wheel through One More Saturday Night was broadcast on Grateful Dead Hour 490; Soundboard from master reels to DAT, DAT, Sonic Solutions, CD, CD, then SHN; seeded via David Gans, then Chuck Kiefe and Chuck Fiske; Hosted at gdlive.com; a separate sbe-fixed version also circulates [4][7]
